text:
Submit items for Calendar of Events at www.theet.com, email to news@wvnews.com, fax to 304-624-4188 or mail to The Exponent Telegram, P.O. Box 2000, Clarksburg, W.Va. 26302. Items should be brief and must include a contact person and phone number. Deadline for submission is noon Monday through Friday. The Exponent Telegram recommends readers confirm events before attending.
Through July 31
Art Gallery at James & Law, 8 a.m.-5 p.m. Monday-Friday. Featured artists for July: Debi W. Eastep, watercolor, photography and mixed media; Linda Turner, watercolor; Peter Seguin, mixed media and acrylics; Amber Penland, collage, mixed media & acrylics.
Thursday, July 30
Canceled by NIOSH: Free confidential NIOSH black lung screenings for coal miners, Mylan Park, 500 Mylan Park Lane, Morgantown. Details: 1-888-480-4042 or email cwhsp@cdc.gov
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 9:30 a.m.-2 p.m., Salem City Building. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Friday, July 31
David Schwind Memorial Golf Tournament benefiting WV Caring Hospice & Palliative Care, 10 a.m., Clarksburg Country Club, 199 Club Drive, Clarksburg. Registration: https://www.wvcaring.org/wv-caring-events/ For more information, contact Mike Bell at mbell@wvcaring.org or 727-798-4401.
Victory High School Class of 1958 monthly dinner, 4:30 p.m., The Gourmet Cafe Restaurant, Glen Elk. Jim, 304-622-6147.
Saturday, Aug. 1
Roosevelt-Wilson Class of 1965 monthly brunch, 11 a.m., FOP Restaurant, Nutter Fort. Alumni, family and friends welcome. 304-745-5444
Monday, Aug. 3
VFW Post 573 House Committee meeting, 6 p.m.; regular meeting to follow at 7 p.m.; both at the VFW Post.
Tuesday, Aug. 4
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
VFW Post 573 Auxiliary meeting, 6:30 p.m. at the VFW Post.
First Friday���s ���Back to School Bash��� in downtown Clarksburg, 4:30-8 p.m. Book bag giveaway and children���s activities on the back lawn of the library; free tarantella dance class at the Waldomore (5:30 p.m.); schools exhibit at the Waldomore all evening; Art Gallery at the James and Law Co.; Clarksburg History Museum open (10 a.m.-8 p.m.); Model Railroad Club open; downtown businesses and restaurants open late. Mike Spatafore, 304-641-5764.
Wednesday, Aug. 5
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 9:30 a.m.-2 p.m., Lost Creek Community Building. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Friday, Aug. 7
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 9:30 a.m.-2 p.m., East View Community Building. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Fort New Salem Dulcimer Festival. Doors open at 7 p.m.; concert begins at 7:30 p.m. Music, vendors, Appalachian artisans. General admission: $8; children 10 and under free. Details: www.fortnewsalemfoundation.org or 304-695-2220.
Saturday, Aug. 8
Fort New Salem Dulcimer Festival. Music, vendors, Appalachian artisans, hands-on music workshops (registration 304-695-2220, or at the event). Doors open at 7 p.m.; concert begins at 7:30 p.m. General admission: $8; children 10 and under free. Details: www.fortnewsalemfoundation.org or 304-695-2220.
Authentic Unlimited concert, Sue Morris Sports Complex Live Stage, 1294 U.S. 33, Glenville. Gates open at 5 p.m. Opening act Kenny Smith and the Putnam Boys at 7 p.m. Authentic Unlimited at 8 p.m. Donations for the concert are expected and collected at the gate. A dinner will be available by donation.
Sunday, Aug. 9
Knights of Columbus Council 872 annual picnic, 1 p.m., Council Hall at 334 E Pike St. All members and their families are encouraged to attend.
Fort New Salem Dulcimer Festival. Music, vendors, Appalachian artisans, hands-on music workshops (registration 304-695-2220, or at the event). Doors open 9:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.; closing concert with all participants begins at 2:15 p.m. General admission: $8; children 10 and under free. Details: www.fortnewsalemfoundation.org or 304-695-2220.
Monday, Aug. 10
Knights of Columbus Council 872 regular business meeting, 7 p.m., Council Hall at 334 E Pike St. All members are encouraged to attend.
Friends of the Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library meeting, 1 p.m., second-floor Maxwell Meeting Room. All welcome. Cecilia Reid, 304-624-9860.
Tuesday, Aug. 11
Harrison County Association of Retired School Employees monthly picnic, 4 p.m., Maple Shelter at Clarksburg City Park in Nutter Fort. Hot dogs provided. All members & recent retirees invited. Bring a covered dish. Program: Installation of officers.
NARFE Chapter 1579 meeting, 11:30 a.m., Brickside Bar and Grille, 101 Lodgeville Road in Bridgeport. Guest speaker: David Mann, certified laughter leader with the World Laughter Tour and author of ���Humor Therapy: The Art of Smiling for Others.��� National Active and Retired Federal Employees President Bill O���Field, 304-627-8175; Vice President Patty Flanigan, 304-669-5011.
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. Doors open at 6:15 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880, louortenzio@gmail.com.
Wednesday, Aug. 12
Lost Creek Lions Club meeting, 6:30 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Church. Program: Boys State and Girls State students from South Harrison High School sponsored by club. Update on parking lot project by Mayor Dave Oliverio. Dinner by Lost Creek United Methodist Women of Faith. Lions President Davey Wriston, 304-838-0351.
Salem High School Class of 1969 monthly lunch meeting, noon, Bella���s Restaurant, Salem. Salem High School alumni, family, friends welcome. 202-905-1959.
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 9:30 a.m.-2 p.m., West Milford Community Building. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Thursday, Aug. 13
Roosevelt-Wilson Class of 1957 monthly brunch, 11 a.m., FOP Restaurant, Nutter Fort. Alumni, family and friends welcome. 304-566-7397
Friday, Aug. 14
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 11:30 a.m.-2 p.m., Lumberport United Methodist Church. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Saturday, Aug. 15
Back to School backpacks and clothes giveaway, 11 a.m. to 2 p.m., Kelly Miller Community Center, 408 E.B. Saunders Way, Clarksburg. Meal provided. Details: Cathy, 304-476-1434.
Shinnston Party on the Green, noon until midnight, green space along Pike Street in front of the Municipal Building, 242 Pike St. Music by Andy Benson, 3 Teez, Marchshall Lowry Band, with karaoke to follow by Jennifer Tonkery. Free to the public. Bring your own pop-up canopies, food, refreshments. Details: Steve Glass, 304-203-2988.
Monday, Aug. 17
VFW Post 573 House Committee meeting, 6 p.m.; regular meeting to follow at 7 p.m.; both at the VFW Post.
Tuesday, Aug. 18
Clarksburg Retired Postal Employees meeting, 9 a.m., IHOP, Bridgeport. 304-624-4262.
Catholic Daughters of the Americas Court Clarksburg 334 meeting, 6 p.m., Immaculate Conception Parish Center. All Catholic women 18 years old and older are invited to attend and learn about the court. Theresa White, 304-669-6063.
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, noon-7 p.m., Stonewood Fire Department. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Thursday, Aug. 20
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 9:30 a.m.-2 p.m., Spelter Fire Department. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Monday, Aug. 24
Knights of Columbus Council 872 installation of officers dinner, 7 p.m., Council Hall at 334 E Pike St. All members are encouraged to attend. Call Doug White at 304-623-1302 to register by Aug. 20.
Tuesday, Aug. 25
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 9:30 a.m.-12:30 p.m., Summit Park Fire Department. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Wednesday, Aug. 26
Harrison County assessment and tax satellite event, 8 a.m.-6 p.m., General Services Building, downtown Clarksburg. Residents can receive assistance with assessments, farm census, exemptions, and pay personal property or real estate taxes at any location.
Saturday, Sept. 19
Northeast Region of the Huntington���s Disease Society of America (HDSA) will host the 2026 HDSA Tennessee Chapter Education Day, 11 a.m.-3 p.m., at 515 W. Main St., Bridgeport. Local opportunity for members of the HD community to join with friends, family members, neighbors and community at large to raise necessary awareness and funds to support HDSA. Online registration, full schedule, at https://give.hdsa.org/event/2026-patient-education-day-west-virginia/e807883
